itemList.description: Supplying, Placing & Compacting Ready Made Plant mixedCold Bituminous Pothole patching mix in accordance with IRC 116-2014 in 50kgs plastic sturdy bags. The mix shall contain at least 5.6% MC 800 Cutback Bitumen conforming to IS 217 Specification and suitable anti-stripping agent @ 0.3% by weight. The mix shall be workable for at least 6 months. The material shall be intended for patching potholes up to 40mm thick layers and for deeper potholes the mix shall be placed and compacted in 40 mm thick layers & complete as per technical specifications. and Engineer In Charge of the Work
Providing, and supplying of 20mm and down size aggreegate and Engineer In Charge of the Work
Providing, and supplying of Bitumen emulsion SS2 and Engineer In Charge of the Work
